info.title: aibysitter 0.4.2 (ruleset
info.description: Lints rules files for AI coding agents (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions, GEMINI.md, .windsurfrules). Same rules and scoring as aibysitting.net. Runs offline.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Lints a rules file for AI coding agents. Same rules and scoring as aibysitting.net. Runs offline.

options.name: --format
options.description:
Auto, Markdown, ClaudeMd, AgentsMd, CursorMdc, CursorRules, CopilotInstructions, GeminiMd, WindsurfRules.
Default: from the file path, else detected from content.
claude, agents, gemini, copilot, cursor, cursorrules, windsurf.

options.name: --disable
options.description: Rule IDs to skip, comma-separated, for example R002,R005.

options.name: --json
options.description: JSON output, same fields as the /api/lint response plus "file".

options.name: --fail-on-error
options.description: Exit 1 when any Error finding remains.

options.name: --fail-below
options.description: Exit 1 when the grade is below A, B, C or D.

options.name: --stdin-path
options.description:
With -, names standard input: the format comes from this path and the report uses it.
fix: fixes R011 (deletes empty headings) and R012 (closes the fence at end of file), repeated until none
apply. Writes the file in place. With -, writes the fixed text to standard output.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print a unified diff instead; exit 1 when there are changes.
init: writes a rules file composed from packs, then prints its score.

options.name: --packs
options.description: Pack IDs, comma-separated, in order. 'aibysitter packs' lists them.

options.name: --title
options.description: H1 of the file. Default: Project rules.

options.name: --output
options.description: Default: where the format goes, for example CLAUDE.md or .cursor/rules/<pack>.mdc.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite an existing file.
hook claude-code: Claude Code PostToolUse hook. Reads the hook JSON on standard input; when the edited
file is a rules file with Error or Warning findings, prints them to standard error and exits 2 so Claude
fixes them. Otherwise exits 0. Extra flags also come from AIBYSITTER_HOOK_ARGS (--disable only).
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 threshold failed (lint) or changes found (fix --dry-run), 2 usage error, 3 file not readable or not writable, 4 lint timed out.
